points.headline: Exports are failing for them
points.detail: Large CSV exports time out and scheduled ones fail silently since v2.4. Rohan said it blocks month-end close.

points.headline: We missed the export promise
points.detail: Scheduled exports were promised at the Q3 review and that date has passed. Say so plainly.

points.headline: How is finance closing the month?
points.detail: Finance usage fell most, and Priya says they reconcile by hand. Learn the cost and what would unblock them.

points.headline: Give a real fix date
points.detail: The export fix is late. Offer a date you can keep and a status update until it ships.

points.headline: Book finance onboarding
points.detail: Dedicated finance onboarding is still open from the last review. Propose times in this meeting.

points.headline: Usage down before renewal
points.detail: Usage fell sharply since v2.4 and health is 54. Another missed date puts renewal at risk.

hypotheses.title: v2.4 broke large and scheduled exports
hypotheses.explanation: v2.4 changed exports just before the drop; export use fell about 71%, and three tickets describe timeouts and silent failures.
hypotheses.howToConfirm: Compare Acme export errors before and after v2.4.

hypotheses.title: Finance left the product for month-end
hypotheses.explanation: Finance use fell about 62%, and they say they reconcile by hand because scheduled exports stopped.
hypotheses.howToConfirm: Ask Priya if finance moved month-end reporting to spreadsheets.

hypotheses.title: Fewer seats, not less engagement
hypotheses.explanation: A billing ticket questions the seat count, so a smaller roster could explain part of the drop.
hypotheses.howToConfirm: Compare active seats this month with the last invoice.
